name: Packed Quad Vertex Format
definition: A GPU-ready packed vertex structure for voxel, terrain, and simple UI geometry, designed to reduce memory bandwidth and VRAM usage by packing normals, colors, and UV metadata into a single 32-bit field.
summary: Packed Quad Vertex Format is a GPU-ready structure that minimizes memory usage by packing vertex metadata into a single 32-bit integer, distinct from floating-point storage.
